sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: When a page of a multi-page listing finally fails and the run stops short, the status line now offers a "↻ Load remaining pages" button beside the "⚠️ Loaded 37 of 40 pages — INCOMPLETE" it explains. Pressing it carries on from the page that failed and keeps everything already on screen; the 37 pages that did arrive are not fetched again. Hover it to see exactly which page it will start at.

Repeat it as often as you like: if the next page fails too, the offer comes back pointing at that one instead. When the run finally completes the warning and the button both disappear on their own, and the status line goes back to saying how many pages it loaded.

This replaces the only answer available before, which was to press the button again — and still is, if you want a genuinely fresh start. That path reloads the page and re-fetches everything from page 1, and it is unchanged.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Resuming asks MusicBrainz for nothing it already knows: the page count is reused rather than re-requested, so the "⚠️ High Page Count" confirmation does not appear a second time for pages you already agreed to.
